name: Harmor
description: Advanced additive engine with subtractive-style workflow for synthesis, resynthesis, and complex modulation.
soundCharacter: Clean, detailed, and highly controllable; can be smooth or aggressive.
cpuUsage: Medium to High depending on patch complexity.
proTips: Use image resynthesis for unique textures
Drag and drop images into the 'IMG' tab for resynthesis
Use the 'Prism' knob for unique detuning effects
Right-click the filter envelope to create complex rhythmic sequences
Use 'Unison' with 'Pitch' and 'Pan' variation for massive supersaws

controls.label: Mix/Wet
controls.listenFor: Balance between dry signal and processed signal

troubleshooting.solution: Lower input gain or output volume.

name: Maximus
description: Multiband compressor/limiter/maximizer for mastering and precise dynamics control.
soundCharacter: Can be transparent or colored depending on settings; capable of strong loudness.
proTips: Compare with bypass at matched loudness
Draw custom compression curves for unique dynamic control
Use the 'Linear Phase' mode for mastering to preserve phase coherence

controls.label: Bands (Low/Mid/High)
controls.listenFor: Separation of Bass, Vocals, and Cymbals

controls.label: Compression Envelopes
controls.listenFor: Drawing the 'knee' for transparency or grit

troubleshooting.solution: Increase Release time on the active band.

name: Sytrus
description: Powerhouse hybrid synthesizer combining FM (Frequency Modulation), Subtractive, and Additive synthesis with a modulation matrix
soundCharacter: Clean, digital, and precise. Can be warm (filters), cold/metallic (FM), or aggressive (Waveshaping). High-fidelity audio engine.
cpuUsage: Low to Moderate. Very efficient for its power. High unison/oversampling increases load.
proTips: Right-click an operator to 'Analyze Audio' and resynthesize samples
Use the 'Pluck' mode in the delay section for Karplus-Strong synthesis
Drag and drop DX7 SysEx files onto Sytrus to load classic 80s patches
Use the waveshaper in the filter section for grit/distortion
Enable 'Gibbs' in harmonics editor to smooth out sharp edges
Use 'Global' tab quality settings to save CPU during composition

controls.label: Operators 1-6
controls.listenFor: Pitch ratios defining the harmonic series

troubleshooting.solution: Reduce modulation amounts in the Matrix.
Check 'Oversampling' settings in the main tab.
